When will I use this?

Ratio: when will I use this?

Whenever things have to be mixed in the right amounts.

Bricklayer

Construction and the built environment

\(\displaystyle 1 : 2 : 3\)

How much cement goes in 0.3 m³ of concrete?

Concrete for a shed base is often mixed \(1 : 2 : 3\): 1 part cement, 2 parts sand, 3 parts gravel, in buckets of the same size. You need 0.3 m³ of dry mix.

  1. Total parts: \(1 + 2 + 3 = 6\).
  2. One part: \(0.3 \div 6 = 0.05\) m³.
  3. Cement 0.05 m³, sand 0.10 m³, gravel 0.15 m³.

The answer: \(0.3 \div 6 = 0.05\) m³ per part

Hairdresser

Hair and beauty

\(\displaystyle 1 : 2\)

How much developer for 40 g of colour?

Colour is mixed with developer in the ratio the maker gives. Wella's Koleston Perfect is mixed \(1 : 1\), but its Special Blonde shades are mixed \(1 : 2\). You use 40 g of a Special Blonde shade.

  1. Colour : developer = \(1 : 2\).
  2. Developer = \(40 \times 2 = 80\) g.

The answer: \(40 \times 2 = 80\) g of developer

Hospital nurse

Health and science

\(\displaystyle \text{dose} = \dfrac{\text{want}}{\text{have}} \times \text{volume}\)

How many ml is a 125 mg dose?

Liquid medicine comes at a strength, such as 250 mg in 5 ml. Nurses use: volume = what you want ÷ what you have × what it is in. The prescription is 125 mg. The bottle says 250 mg in 5 ml.

  1. \(125 \div 250 = 0.5\).
  2. \(0.5 \times 5 = 2.5\) ml.

The answer: \(125 \div 250 \times 5 = 2.5\) ml

Bike mechanic

Engineering and manufacturing

\(\displaystyle \text{gear ratio} = \dfrac{\text{chainring}}{\text{cog}}\)

Which gear gets you up the hill?

The gear ratio is the chainring's teeth ÷ the rear cog's teeth: how many times the back wheel turns for one turn of the pedals.

  1. 48-tooth chainring, 16-tooth cog: \(48 \div 16 = 3\) turns.
  2. Change to a 32-tooth cog for hills: \(48 \div 32 = 1.5\) turns, easier to pedal, slower.

The answer: \(48 \div 16 = 3\) wheel turns per pedal turn

Nursery practitioner

Education and childcare

\(\displaystyle 1 : 5\)

How many staff does this room legally need?

By law there must be at least 1 adult for every 5 two-year-olds in a nursery in England. The two-year-olds' room has 13 children.

  1. \(13 \div 5 = 2.6\), and you can't have 0.6 of an adult, so round up: 3 staff.

The answer: \(13 \div 5 = 2.6\), so 3 adults

Hair colourist

Hair and beauty

\(\displaystyle 1 : 2\)

How much colour goes in a 60 ml mix?

Uses example figures: the numbers marked (example figure) or (example figures) are made up to show the method.

Developer strength is sold in "volumes": 10 vol is 3% hydrogen peroxide, so 20 vol is 6%. A common mix is 1 part colour to 2 parts developer. A 60 ml mix at \(1 : 2\) (example figure):

  1. Strength: \(20 \div 10 \times 3 = 6\%\).
  2. Colour: \(60 \div 3 = 20\) ml. Developer: \(20 \times 2 = 40\) ml.

The answer: \(60 \div 3 = 20\) ml of colour

Practise it

Games on MaffsGames that practise ratio:

  • Split It: Simplify ratios, find equivalents, share amounts in a ratio, scale recipes and use the unitary method.
  • Proportion Blaster: Direct and inverse proportion problems, and sharing in a ratio.
  • I Found a Mark: Break big exam questions into steps and bank the method marks: choose the calculations a marker credits, never the answer.
